prompt_en: Create a photorealistic sports-editorial photograph on a rain-soaked rooftop at blue-hour dawn. Two unmistakably adult women sprint through a relay exchange zone. Long lightweight timing ribbons, caught by gusts, stream as kinetic wind arcs around the runners. Show the principal runner full body from a limited rear three-quarter angle, her adult face readable in a natural over-shoulder turn and her long wet dark hair swept forward. A back/limited rear three-quarter full-body view must keep both shoulders, straps, upper spine, lower band, and the full outfit inspectable. She wears a racerback sports bra with high-waisted performance leggings: two separate shoulder straps leave the left and right shoulders and remain independently traceable before convergence; both straps visibly converge between the shoulder blades at the central upper back; one narrow Y-shaped racerback yoke continues below the convergence along the upper spine; the central yoke remains visibly attached to the lower bra band in one continuous garment structure; parallel straps, an X crossing, and a halter neck remain visibly excluded by the topology. The teammate stays in the far lateral plane; the teammate places a metal relay baton into her backward-reaching open hand at hip height, with the handoff visibly mid-contact and the upper back clear. Route the wind ribbons through the outer foreground and frame edges, leaving the shoulder-blade area open while rain-darkened fabric echoes acceleration. Use the supplied portrait solely as appearance guidance for an original unmistakably adult principal subject's face, dark long hair, and general appearance; appearance continuity remains separate from biometric identity verification. Realistic rain droplets, wet fabric tension, hand contact, puddle reflections, rooftop rails, storm light, and a slim skylight rim establish weather, depth, and speed. Use a low trailing 35 mm camera angle with crisp garment topology and slight motion blur on ribbons and shoes.
